visual.title: The tail stays inside epsilon
visual.caption: The shaded band is the epsilon-neighbourhood of the limit. The threshold marks the first index after which every later term stays inside the band.

predict.question: For 1/n with epsilon 0.2, from which n does every later term stay inside?
predict.explain: 1/n is below 0.2 exactly when n is greater than 5, so the tail from n = 5 stays inside.
